channel.title: mint - news
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: ‘No VIP attitude’: Shreyas Iyer, Tilak Varma wait in regular dinner queue after Asian Games Gold in Japan | Viral video
item.description: Asian Games gold medalists Shreyas Iyer and Tilak Varma are winning hearts online after being spotted waiting patiently in a regular dinner queue with no VIP attitude.

item.title: Brazil election: Why Lula and Flavio Bolsonaro are headed for a high-stakes runoff
item.description: Brazil election: Brazil’s presidential election is headed for a runoff between incumbent Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva and right-wing Senator Flavio Bolsonaro after neither candidate secured more than 50% of the first-round vote.&nbsp;

item.title: Festival season: No local vendor or hawker should be ‘evicted or deprived of livelihoods,’ NHRC tells states
item.description: The NHRC statement came amid complaints about the “unnecessary” removal of local vendors and hawkers in various cities, the seizure of their goods, the imposition of fines, and harassment.

item.title: ‘He was openly radicalized’: Aviation veteran on Flydubai attack, security gaps and emergency landing | Exclusive
item.description: Aviation veteran Alastair Rosenschein said signs of the Flydubai co-pilot’s radicalization were visible to security services, colleagues and family. He praised Indian Captain Smit Machchhar’s bravery and called for stronger crew screening, psychological testing and international information sharing.

item.title: Why a Tamil Nadu widow wants CM Vijay’s free bus scheme declared ‘unconstitutional’: Plea in Madras HC today
item.description: N Kalamani, a private bus operator from Erode, filed a writ petition in the Madras High Court, challenging the constitutional validity of the Tamil Nadu government's ‘Vettri Payanam’ scheme, a report claimed.

item.title: Indian Bank manager death: Chennai tragedy sparks fresh debate on workplace pressure
item.description: 57-year-old Indian Bank Manager stepped out of his office and was standing near the balcony just before the incident occurred

item.title: Researcher dies of ‘unknown infection’ at Russia's plague lab, at least 200 quarantined: Here's what we know so far
item.description: A researcher at Russia’s Anti-Plague Research Institute died after developing severe pneumonia, prompting quarantine measures and an investigation. Authorities are probing conflicting reports about whether she contracted a dangerous infection during travel or after a laboratory accident.

item.title: ‘Got the law involved’: FBI Director Kash Patel gets engaged to longtime girlfriend | Who is Alexis Wilkins?
item.description: The two have been dating since “long before” Kash Patel took over as head of the FBI in 2025, when she attended his swearing-in.&nbsp;

item.title: ‘Planned it even before I was hired’: What Flydubai co-pilot told investigators days after tragedy averted
item.description: The Flydubai co-pilot accused of attacking Captain Smit Machchhar mid-air allegedly planned the attack before joining the airline. Investigators are probing his previous trips to Israel, career history, possible motive and links to Australia.

item.title: US removes B-1 bombers from UK base over Iran ‘terror plot’, expert exposes ‘vulnerabilities’: What we know so far
item.description: A dozen B-1 bombers had been stationed at Fairford, northwest of London, and were used in US strikes on Iran.

item.title: Petrol and diesel prices today, October 5: Check fuel cost in Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru
item.description: Indian refiners are currently dealing with the impact of geopolitical disruptions on global crude oil and fuel markets. Yet, the OMCs have kept fuel rates steady

item.title: Iran war news LIVE Updates: Pakistan leaders visit Riyadh for meeting under Mecca defense agreement
item.description: Iran war news LIVE Updates: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi warned, “If the enemies once again choose the path of military confrontation and war, Iran’s response will be much stronger and more decisive than in the past.”

item.title: Pentagon Redeploys Bombers From UK Base at Center of Terror Plot
item.description: The Pentagon has removed bombers based at the Royal Air Force base in the UK that was at the center of a suspected attempted terrorist attack last week.

item.title: N. Korea’s Kim Oversaw Hypersonic Missile Drill, KCNA Says
item.description: North Korean leader Kim Jong Un oversaw the launch of an intermediate-range strategic missile using a hypersonic weapons system, state media said, underscoring his intent to further strengthen the country’s nuclear deterrent.

item.title: Steven Baker joins CBS News as consultant to help improve ‘CBS Mornings’ and ‘CBS Evening News’
item.description: CBS News has brought in former ABC News ‘Nightline’ executive producer Steven Baker as a consultant as it looks to strengthen ‘CBS Mornings’ and ‘CBS Evening News’ amid continued ratings pressure.

item.title: Meet Nishant Kerketta: 'Gaon ka ladka' from Jharkhand goes viral for turning his village backdrop into a fashion stage
item.description: Nishant Kerketta, a fashion and fitness enthusiast from Jharkhand, is going viral on Instagram after showcasing a polished outfit in a video that playfully challenges assumptions about how men from villages dress.

item.title: SIR voter list: Form 6, 7, 8 or 9? Which form to use for Aadhaar, address change, name deletion
item.description: Some of these forms are part of the Registration of Electors Rules, 1960, which set out how electoral rolls are prepared and revised.

item.title: UK family transforms 1980s home into mini power station and secures five years without energy bills
item.description: A family in Milton Keynes has turned its 1980s house into a self-generating energy system using solar panels, a heat pump and battery storage, allowing it to join a five-year tariff designed to eliminate energy bills.

item.title: Who are 'Gen Next Mumbai'? Why did they protest against Abhijeet Dipke and CJP amid Shivaji Park protest?
item.description: A group of youth protested against Cockroach Janta Party and its founder Abhijeet Dipke near the statue of Babasaheb Ambedkar at Churchgate, Mumbai.&nbsp;

item.title: FSSAI flags Everest cumin powder as unsafe, orders immediate market recall: What food analyst report found
item.description: FSSAI has ordered Everest Food Products to withdraw unsafe pre-packed cumin powder. The regulator emphasises strict enforcement of food safety regulations to protect consumers.

item.title: FlyDubai attack: Israel had crew list, so how did ‘barred’ pilot evade checks? What we know
item.description: Officials have previously said that the co-pilot, who was from Oman, had been prohibited from flying in his home country over concerns linked to his extremist views.

item.title: Rising global capital costs pose challenge for emerging economies: Anurada Thakur
item.description: Pointing to changes in global financial markets, economic affairs secretary Anuradha Thakur said bond markets were assuming a larger share of financing, with government papers alone accounting for more than 80% of global gross domestic product.&nbsp;

item.title: RightForge is back 4 years after shutting down over Truth Social’s $1.6 million unpaid bill, with a new owner
item.description: RightForge, previously shut down over a dispute with Donald Trump's Truth Social, is relaunching under new ownership by John Freeman. He aims to provide cloud hosting and internet infrastructure services while promoting free speech and independent media.

item.title: Traffic exists everywhere, but what makes Ireland’s roads feel safer? Indian woman explains
item.description: In an Instagram video, Deepali Thukral compared driving conditions in Ireland with what she has experienced elsewhere, highlighting the role of lane discipline, patience and consideration for pedestrians.

item.title: ‘Salary stuck in 2006, rent in 2046’: Bengaluru resident's housing cost rant goes viral
item.description: he said. The resident then underlined an ‘absolute mathematical comedy’ between corporate salaries and rental prices in areas such as New Thippasandra and Indiranagar.

item.title: India’s resilience to global shocks built on broad reforms: Shaktikanta Das
item.description: Speaking at the Kautilya Economic Conclave, Das said that reforms such as flexible inflation targeting, the goods and services tax, digital payments and banking sector reforms were not designed as one-off measures but as buffers that allow the economy to absorb disruptions and recover rapidly.

item.title: US Green Card holder’s mother denied B1/B2 visa, leaves her perplexed; internet warns, ‘Never say that you are funding…’
item.description: During the interview, the consular officer asked her about the purpose of her travel, how the trip would be sponsored, her previous international travel history.

item.title: Expulsion, suspension, reflection papers: How Cornell University punished seven accused in frat house rape case
item.description: Jane Doe filed a civil lawsuit against Cornell university, alleging that she was drugged and raped at a fraternity house at the university. She said that the institution didn't protect her or punish the men involved adequately.

item.title: Why did AAP suspend its MLA in Punjab? All you need to know about Sukhveer Singh Maiserkhana
item.description: Aam Aadmi Party MLA Sukhveer Singh Maiserkhana criticised party leadership and the Punjab government for not addressing the teacher shortage in his constituency. The AAP subsequently suspended him for alleged indiscipline.

item.title: French student protests escalate: Up to 500 schools to remain closed on Monday, 5 October
item.description: Up to 500 French high schools will be partly or fully closed on Monday as protests over teacher shortages, overcrowding and poor facilities intensify, with authorities citing security concerns after schools were damaged and clashes erupted.

item.title: Want to be Argentine citizen? There are 2 routes: ₹3.37 crore payment or ₹7.71 crore bond | ‘Golden Passport’ Explained
item.description: Under the new programme, foreign applicants will have two investment routes to obtain Argentine citizenship.

item.title: FCNR has bought time; now let's transform how we finance our current account deficit: Neelkanth Mishra
item.description: Mishra said the FCNR scheme acts as a way to buy more time, effectively lengthening short-term currency hedges—which used to mature in three to six months—into three- to five-year commitments. &nbsp;

item.title: FlyDubai incident: Co-pilot who attacked Captain Smit Machchhar was removed by Oman Air over radical views? New claims
item.description: The co-pilot identified as Hamam al-Hammami, 29, attacked Captain Smit Machchhar with an axe allegedly in an attempt to crash the flight with more than 170 passengers. His motive behind the attack remains unknown.

item.title: India hikes deepwater gas price ceiling to $9.89 for difficult fields; Reliance-BP’s KG-D6 to benefit
item.description: The government has raised the ceiling price for natural gas produced from difficult fields such as the KG-D6 block of Reliance Industries and BP to USD 9.89 per million British thermal units (MMBtu) for the six months beginning October 1

item.title: Cuba offers land to Indian firms for food production amid US blockade
item.description: Cuba's food security crisis prompts Ambassador Juan Carlos Marsán Aguilera to suggest co-producing rice, beans, and sugarcane with Indian firms. Amid escalating US sanctions, Cuba aims to improve energy self-sufficiency and deepen trade relations with India.
